segments.text: Ryousuke's classmate who is part of the graduation album production committee. Energetic, friendly, serious and funny, Natsuki is almost considered the committee's mascot. It is known throughout the school, both by students and teachers. She captures every moment of the students' lives to photograph them, her motto is that a photo is a bridge between the past, the present and the future.
卒業アルバム制作委員会所属のクラスメイト。
よりよい学園生活を形に残すため、行事関連やイベントでカメラのシャッターをきる。
中途半端な事は嫌いで、白か黒か、YesかNoにこだわる。
そのため、ピンボケの写真を撮った時は「死にたい…」とつぶやき肩を落とす。
青春を未来のみんなに渡す為、今日もカメラを手に校舎を走り回っている。

Ryousuke's senpai. Her father is the director of the aquarium Marinpia Shionagi, which closed down recently. She loves the ocean and all marine life and is extremely knowledgeable about them.
海と魚、そして自然の雄大さをこよなく愛する、
天真爛漫、真面目でちょっぴり変なお嬢様。
父親はかつて水族館の館長を勤めており、自身も大の水族館好き。

「私、全力で約束します！　あなたを素敵な気持ちにさせることを！」
"Eternal Dreamer (永遠の夢追い人(エターナルドリーマー))"
Protagonist's one year younger junior who won't hesitate help anyone in trouble.
There is absolutely no limit to how good she is at making friends, she sticks her head right in into any kinds of trouble and events.
Hinata has many dreams that can be considered her future dream job and all of them give off impression of a "gal's".
She loves animals, especially dogs.
一歳年下の後輩。
友達が多く、人なつっこく、困っている人がいたら手をさしのべずにはいられない。
友達作りの境界線は皆無で、面倒事にもイベント事にも、自分から首を突っ込んでいく。
将来の夢がとにかく多いがどれもギャルっぽい職業ばかり。
動物、特に犬が好き。
主人公のひとつ年下の後輩。人なつっこく、友達が多い。
困っている人に手を差し伸べずにはいられない性格で、面倒事に自分から首を突っ込んでいくことも。
将来の夢はたくさんあるが、どれもギャルっぽい職業ばかり。動物が大好き。
"Drama-Enthusiastic Girl Who Longs for the Stage (舞台に憧れる演劇少女)"
A classmate sitting next to the protagonist.
Momiji is very interested in theater drama, after school she reads her favorite books aloud like it was script to practice.

Normally she appears to be absent-minded and a little clumsy, but is capable of completely surprising the surroundings with something she suddenly says. Her image completely changes when she stands on the stage, she appears very bold and dashing.
Momiji uses her favorite hair tie instead of a bookmarker.
隣の席のクラスメイト。
演劇に大きな興味を持っており、放課後には、愛読書を台本代わりに読んで、こっそり練習している。
普段はぽやっとしていて、少しおっちょこちょい。
突拍子もない発言で、周囲を驚かせたりすることも。
しかし、舞台の上に立てばそのイメージを覆して、堂々とした立ち振る舞いを見せる。
お気に入りのヘアゴムが名札代わり。
主人公と席が隣同士になった女の子。
演劇に大きな興味を持っており、放課後に愛読書を台本代わりにこっそり練習している。
普段は"ぽやっ"としていて、少々おっちょこちょい。突拍子もない発言で、周囲を驚かせることもしばしば。
"Noble Silver Bird Dancing on Ice (氷上を舞う気高き銀鳥)"
A figure skater who aims to become the world champion.
She is the protagonist's childhood friend with whom he has reunited after spending two years abroad training figure skating.

She's not only famous, but also gives off a cool and mature impression which makes people treat her as an "aloof and cool woman". However, when one gets closer to her they would learn that she's tolerant, accepting and gentle girl.
世界のトップを目指す、フィギュアスケーター。
主人公とは、幼稚園の頃からの幼なじみで、2年間のスケート留学を経て、再開を果たす。
有名人であることに加え、クールで大人びた印象も手伝って、孤高で“かっこいい女”として、広く認識されている。
しかし一歩踏み出してみれば、包容力と思いやりのある、優しい少女を見つけることができる。
世界トップクラスのフィギュアスケーターで、主人公とは幼稚園からの幼なじみ。
2年間のスケート留学を経て再会した。
クールで大人びた印象から、孤高の"かっこいい女性アスリート"と広く認識されている。
しかし、ごく近しい人は彼女の包容力と深い思いやりを知っている。
"A Step Sister Who Can't Get Used to Being a Younger Sister (妹になりきれない義妹)"
The little step sister of the protagonist, the two are having a hard time grasping the distance in their relationship. She's a very reserved girl.
The protagonist's father and her mother have remarried, and they have come to live together a year before the story starts.

The two still haven't completely opened their hearts to each other and she has yet to call him "onii-chan". However, as the two spend their time together, she gradually opens herself to him and grows attached to him, acting spoiled like a puppy.
Although she's meek, the core of her personality is strong and she's the type to work hard towards a goal.
Yuzuki loves sweets.
微妙な距離感のある、引っ込み思案な義妹。
主人公の父親と、雪月の母が再婚し、一緒に暮らし始めたのが一年前。
まだ主人公と打ち解けておらず、「おにーちゃん」と呼べずにいる。
しかし、同じ時を過ごすことで徐々に心を開き、子犬のように懐いて甘えるようになっていく。
大人しいながらも芯は強く、こつこつと努力を重ねるタイプ。
好きなものはお菓子。
主人公の父親の再婚相手の連れ子。
元来の引っ込み思案な性格もあり当初は微妙な距離感があったが、一度心を開くと子犬のように慕い甘えてくる。
大人しいながらも芯は強く、こつこつと努力を重ねていくタイプの少女。お菓子が好き。

segments.text: "Transfer Student from the Northern Country (北の国からの転校生)"
A transfer student who has come from Canada. Her long blonde, straight hair and clear blue eyes leave a strong impression on people.

She is calm and doesn't show her emotions too much. Because she's still learning Japanese, Bethly talks using only the absolute minimum of words which makes her leave a cool and emotionless impression.
But her actual personality is the opposite of her cold appearance, she is very delicate and kind.
Bethly is great at drawing.
カナダからやってきた転校生。
ブロンドのロングヘアーと、澄んだブルーの瞳が印象的。
大人しく、あまり感情を表に出さない。日本語を勉強中なこととも相まって、
最小限の言葉だけで会話しようとするので、クールで無表情な印象を持たれてしまう。
その冷たそうな見た目に反して、繊細で優しい感性の持ち主。
絵を描くのが得意。
カナダからやってきた、ブロンドのロングヘアーとブルーの瞳が印象的な転校生。
あまり感情を表に出さない性格と日本語を勉強中なことが相まって、クールで無愛想だと思われがち。
実際は繊細で優しい感性を持ち、絵を描くことが得意。
A honor student with good reputation in the school.
He has a personality that makes him get along well with people, is very caring and attentive. Yukito can't leave people in trouble and will take on the work others don't want to do.
Often told by his surroundings that he's too good of a person.
"Unmotivated Trainee Teacher (やる気のない教育実習生)"

A music college student who becomes a trainee teacher in the middle school the protagonist is attending. Very serious and working hard to become an educator... is what she pretends to be like. She's a rascal who only puts up appearances.

She loves anything that will benefit her and wants to have the best results with the least effort. Momoka finds doing anything really bothersome. Having to prepare for adult life, she thinks of getting a teachers' license just in case.
"Protagonist's Real Mother (主人公の実母)"

The protagonist's real mother, a pro violinist who mainly works within Hokkaido. She has a childish and innocent personality, there's always a smile on her face. Maria loves her son a lot and showers him with affection.
She has divorced with her husband as she chose to pursue music and now lives in her aunt's home. Since her home is a cafeteria called "hololo", she helps out there when she's done with practice.
"The Easygoing Vet (のんびり獣医師)"
A veterinarian working in Hororo City.

Normally he appears to be absentminded and unmotivated, but whenever he does something related to animals or is in front of animal patients, he turns into a "capable man". He is also a first class veterinarian.
Reiji is trusted well by the pet owners who come to his animal clinic and is very popular among all kinds of people.
"Passionate Head of the Drama Club (情熱溢れる演劇部部長)"
The president of the drama club who's in the same year as the protagonist and Momiji, and who is very serious about drama plays. Has very strong sense of responsibility.

Akane has a very strict, rigorous personality and does act like a male friend towards the protagonist. She doesn't like to be treated like a girl, but will get angry if treated like a guy which makes it a bit of a pain for her friends.

segments.text: "Little Absolute Champion (小さな絶対王者)"
A figure skater from the same generation as Mizuha and the top athlete who is said to carry Russia in figure skating.
Unlike her small stature, Alyssa's personality is very ambitious and she does not spare any effort in getting better.
In the past, she has lost to Mizuha just once and since then, she has been treating Mizuha as her rival.
